verdict.rationale: A state agency's online tax and workforce services could plausibly offer a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only web applications (UTR, UTS) and a desktop QuickFile tool for uploading formatted files; probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec, and the application host refused agent connections. There is no evidence of a documented public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
